main_text.head: AUCTORITAS ORACULI Per prædictorum IMPLEMENTUM DEMONSTRATA.
main_text.p: §. 1. Sententia hæc præsens, ante rei eventum in populo promulgata, & cum rebus, postmodum gestis, collata, cum quoad supplicium impiorum in populo judaico, tum quoad afflictionum instrumentum, exactum in historiâ invenit implementum.

N. Initia evectionis Chaldæorum (quam gentem se suscitare ad improborum supplicium dicit Deus) invenimus sub Nebucadnezare primo, secundi parente, qui in Canone Ptolomæi Nabo pol-assar audit, xxi annorum rex; hic anno Æ. Nabon. 123. Per. Jul. 4089 rex creatus, anno Æ. Nabon. 144. Per. Jul. 4110 morte decessit. Hic Scythis Asiam infestantibus, viribusque Assyriorum partim per Medos fractis, partim per Scythas oppressis, regnum suscepit, illudque adversus Scytharum incursiones sartum tectum conservavit, nulli serviens: à quo tempore gens Chaldæorum, antehac obscura, inclaruit, lacertasque suas movere incepit. Clarior autem evasit, quando, sub istius regis finem, non so-lum

page.notes: Running head: the chapter reference at the right ("Cap. I: 5.") is read as "5.[?]", the last character is unclear. The initial S of the first paragraph is a woodcut letter, read as S and joined to "ententia". Italics in the second paragraph ("quam gentem se suscitare", "Chaldæorum", "Nebucadnezare", "Nabo pol-assar") are judged from the scan and may be slightly off. The page ends mid-sentence with "so-" / "lum" split across the line; the printed hyphen is kept. No catchword and no signature are visible.
